column1: # Last real data refresh: 2026-11-07 — 9/30/2026 rows added for all 26 banks; every 6/30/2026 row recomputed from the primary, 0 differences (AGENTS/REGINALD/scripts/call_report_ledgers.py). ⚠️ BASIS AT FFIEC 031 FILERS: TotalLoans, item 9.a and Memo 10 are RCON (domestic offices); Unfunded, nonaccrual and past-due are RCFD (consolidated). Do not divide across those two groups at a 031 filer. Built 2026-08-20 — FFIEC CDR REST/JWT, RetrieveFacsimile/SDF, ALL rows at the FFIEC primary. PURPOSE: decomposed NDFI (bank lending to non-depository financial institutions), built 2026-08-20 to test whether the 8/14+ bank selloff sorted on private-credit exposure. IT DID NOT (see Notes / STATUS). ★ THE DECOMPOSITION IS THE POINT: RC-C item 9.a (MDRM J454) is a HETEROGENEOUS total. RC-C Memo item 10 splits it a/mortgage-credit-intermediaries b/business-credit-intermediaries c/private-equity-funds d/consumer-credit-intermediaries e/other. PC_NDFI = M10b + M10c = the private-credit-relevant slice. Per LESSONS.md [Data] 'NDFI Is Not What It Looks Like': mortgage warehouse != auto subprime != BDC lending — WAL is 68.9% mortgage warehouse and using the J454 TOTAL misranks it badly. UNKNOWN is never coerced to 0 (audit convention 2026-08-12); a reported 0 is data. Large-bank RSSDs resolved by hand and sanity-checked against known loan-book magnitudes — NOT via RetrievePanelOfReporters; all 12 confirmed by name at FDIC BankFind 2026-11-07. JWT expires 2027-01-31. Reproduce: AGENTS/REGINALD/scripts/call_report_ledgers.py; creds and traps in the mi3_cohort_screen.py runbook. || CADENCE (declared 2026-08-20, PROME flag): QUARTERLY, ~45d after quarter-end, RUN ALONGSIDE THE MI3 COHORT SCREEN — next due 2027-02-14 for 2026Q4 (same FFIEC CDR credential, same RSSD set for the 14 MI3 names, JWT expiry 2027-01-31). This is a SCHEDULED pull, not an event-driven one: the data clock advances when the Call Report publishes, whether or not anything moved. || NOT DECLARED 'Cadence: EVENT-DRIVEN' AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: STATE_VOCABULARY Class 8 defines exactly one cadence token today and it means the data clock must NOT advance without a real print (per-voyage premia, canvass-only series). This surface is the opposite - a scheduled quarterly filing. Declaring EVENT-DRIVEN would misdeclare it AND trip the rc-2 misconfiguration path, since that token additionally requires a 'Last re-pull ATTEMPTED:' clock this surface has no use for. The vocabulary has no SCHEDULED/QUARTERLY token yet; flagged to PROME rather than borrowing the wrong one. || SO: if this file reads stale after ~2027-02-17 that is NEGLECT, not design. Before then, writes-behind on this surface is EXPECTED and is not a staleness signal.

# Cadence: SCHEDULED next_due=2027-02-14 — quarterly FFIEC Call Report pull, same clock as MI3_COHORT.tsv (~45d after quarter-end; Q4-2026 data). The data clock is old ON PURPOSE between runs; this is the quiet-until date. (Added 2026-09-26 per DAEDALUS staleness sweep #5.)
